snippet.description:
今天我們來到擁有小江戶之稱的景點「川越」
川越是位在東京近郊~日本埼玉縣的一個美麗城市
這裡至今依然保留著早期江戶時代的傳統建築、藏造老屋
熊野神社與冰川神社也都很值得造訪喔!
走一圈菓子屋橫丁可以買到很多懷舊味的日式糖果點心
街邊更有許多平常看不到的日本傳統小吃
而川越必訪的千年歷史冰川神社，真的非常美麗且氣場強大
來一趟川越好像坐時光機穿越了一樣，是個非常適合安排一日遊的景點
這部影片就和大家分享我們旅途中點點滴滴！

snippet.title: 나혼자 도쿄🗼: 힐링이 필요해.. 감성 터지는 근교여행부터 디즈니랜드, 초면의 일남에게 추천받는츠케멘 맛집까지⭐️도쿄 주말여행 야무지게 팸👊🏻
snippet.description:
안녕하세요 큰형님들!

토요일 저녁 즐겁게 보내고 계신가요?😉
햄들의 일여브를 향한 응원과 사랑 덕분에..! 하코다테에 이어 ⭐️도쿄⭐️ 에서의 광고임무를 수행할 수 있었습니다🙇🏻‍♀️ 감사합니다😭
드디어 (광고)주님의 컨펌을 받고
연차없는 김대리의 도쿄 2박3일 낋여왔으예
예,, 2박 3일이지만 이것 1박2일로 봐도 무방한 ㄷㄷ
하지만 짧은 시간임에도 알차게 쇼핑하구,
제 맘속 탑시크릿 근교여행 성지인 가와고에도 댕겨오구, 디즈니랜드 찍먹까지!  알차게 보낸 주말 이였는데요?
이상하게 승진 이후로 고단하다..고단해..🥹 를 달고 살 정도로 빡세진 김대리 라이프 였거덩요?
그래서 주말의 도피처로 삼은 도쿄가 꽤나 큰 힘(?)이 되어 다시 화이팅 하고 근무 중 이랍니다 헤헤

제가 느낀 힐링과 소소한 행복이 햄들에게도 전염되길 바라며..🩷
오늘도 함께 여행 해 줘서 감사합니다🙇🏻‍♀️

이번 여행과 함께 해 준  세이부 가와고에 패스는 클룩에서 만나볼 수 있어요!
👉🏻 https://www.klook.com/ko/activity/14780-seibu-kawagoe-rail-pass-ikebukuro-tokyo/?spm=SearchResult.SearchResult_LIST&clickId=c13b26aec2
디지털 승차권은 ⭐️온리 클룩⭐️ 이니까 편도보단 왕복패스로 끊어서 조금이라도 더 알차게 감성터지는 근교여행 떠나보자구요? (사실 장어와 고구마가 ㅈㄴ 맛나서 저것들 떵개하러 갈 법 함)

일반열차도 좋지만, 저처럼 조금이라도 더 빨리! 신속히 다녀오고 싶은 햄은 아래의 스무즈 사이트에서 특급권도 추가구매 추천합니도 😉⭐️

今回のライブでは、川越の各町を巡りながら、川越まつり最大の見どころの一つ「曳っかわせ」を求めて歩き回りました。

提灯に照らされた豪華絢爛な山車、響き渡る祭囃子、そして夜の川越を包み込む祭りの熱気。

山車同士が向かい合い、お囃子や踊りを競演する「曳っかわせ」は、川越まつりならではの迫力ある光景です。

今回はライブ配信中に視聴者の皆さんから寄せられたコメントや現地情報を参考に、次の目的地を決めながら移動しました。

「あちらで曳っかわせが行われている」「この町へ行ってみてほしい」といった視聴者からの声をヒントに、川越の町を歩き、祭りの見どころを探していきます。

どこで何が起きているのか、次にどんな光景に出会えるのか。

配信者と視聴者がリアルタイムで情報を共有しながら、一緒に祭りを楽しむことができた、ライブ配信ならではの記録です。

川越まつりは、国の重要無形民俗文化財に指定され、ユネスコ無形文化遺産「山・鉾・屋台行事」の一つにも数えられる伝統行事です。

欢迎观看2026年日本川越祭第一天的夜间盛况！

本次直播记录了10月17日（星期六）川越祭热闹非凡的夜晚。

我们穿行于川越的各个街区，寻找川越祭最精彩的传统活动之一——“曳っかわせ（Hikkawase）”。

在这一传统活动中，华丽的祭典彩车相互面对，车上的乐师与舞者通过祭典音乐和舞蹈进行热闹的交流与竞演。

夜幕降临后，彩车上的灯笼点亮街道，传统音乐此起彼伏，整个川越充满了浓厚的节日气氛。

本次直播最大的特色，是与观众之间的实时互动。

直播过程中，观众们通过留言分享各地的祭典信息，并提出希望前往的地点。

我们根据这些留言和线索，不断调整路线，穿梭于川越的各个街区，共同寻找精彩的“曳っかわせ”表演。

没有完全固定的路线，也无法预知下一刻会遇到什么。

主播与观众实时交流、共同探索，展现了现场直播独有的乐趣与魅力。

川越祭也是联合国教科文组织非物质文化遗产“山、鉾、屋台活动”的组成部分。

snippet.description:
【4K】Japan Walk - Kawagoe 川越 ,Exploring Kawagoe, a Popular short Destination from Tokyo#Japan#Kawagoe#川越

Kawagoe (川越) is located about 30 minutes by train from central Tokyo and is suitable as a day trip destination. Its main street, lined with Kurazukuri (clay-walled warehouse-styled) buildings, retains an ambience reminiscent of an old town from the Edo Period (1603-1867) and allows us to imagine the streets from past centuries. Thereby, Kawagoe became known as "Little Edo".

During the Edo Period, Kawagoe prospered as a supplier of commodities to Tokyo (then named Edo). As Kawagoe was an important city to the capital for trade and strategic purposes, the shogun installed some of their most loyal men as lords of Kawagoe Castle. Close ties ensued between the two cities and over the years, Kawagoe inherited many aspects of the Edo culture and architecture.

One of the most important temples in the Greater Tokyo area, Kitain Temple, is Kawagoe's other main attraction. It is home to the only remaining structures of the former Edo Castle.

Kawagoe is one of the hottest tourist towns near Tokyo, which is getting more popular among foreign travelers. Kawagoe has lots of tourist places to visit like the iconic area Koedo (which means Little Edo in Japanese). Koedo is featured by historical buildings, shrines and temples with the good-old Japanese atmosphere. There are also numerous things to do in Kawagoe from having regional food and drinks to shopping unique traditional items.

snippet.title: 埼玉県川越市大正浪漫夢通りライブカメラ
snippet.description:
川越市は、埼玉県の北西部に位置し、歴史と伝統、そして現代が見事に融合する、まさに唯一無二の景観が広がる都市です。

この地域の景色は、江戸時代の町並みと現代の都市機能、豊かな自然環境が織りなす、他では見られない特別な風景を生み出しています。

snippet.title: Little EDO where FOOD is AMAZING | FIRST time in Kawagoe | Day trip from Tokyo | Japan Vlog
snippet.description:
Join me as I explore Kawagoe : Known as Little EDO for the First time. It has rich history, traditional streets, and unique culinary offerings: Japan Vlog | Day trip from Tokyo

1️⃣ Kitain Temple: Wander through the historic main hall and marvel at the 500 Rakan statues, each with its own expression and story.
2️⃣ Tokino Kane (Time Bell Tower): Hear the timeless chime of this iconic symbol of Kawagoe.
3️⃣ Kurazukuri no Machi: Stroll through this historic warehouse district with its Edo-period charm.
4️⃣ Candy Alley (Kashiya Yokocho): Relive nostalgia with handmade sweets and snacks in this bustling street.
5️⃣ Lunch at Kawagoe Kou Sushi: Savor authentic flavors at a local gem.
6️⃣ Taisho Roman Dori & Crea Mall: Experience a blend of retro vibes and modern shopping to wrap up the day.

snippet.description:
ที่เที่ยวใกล้โตเกียว เดินทางด้วยรถไฟเพียง 30 นาที มาแล้วมาอีกก็ยังสวย
    ก็หวังว่าจะมีประโยชน์กับทุกคน ผู้เริ่มต้น เดินทาง และนักเดินทางทั่วไป
ที่กำลังมองหา ข้อมูลการเดินทาง รีวิวการเดินทาง วิธีการเดินทาง วางแผนการเดินทาง ไป เที่ยวญี่ปุ่นด้วยตัวเอง คนเดียว หรือกับเพื่อน เป็นครอบครัว การเดินทางท่องเทียว โดย รถไฟญี่ปุ่น ใน โตเกียว โอซาก้า เกียวโต ซัปโปโร ฮอกไกโด ไปเล่นสกี หิมะ ดูภูเขาไฟฟูจิ ชมดอกซากุระ หรือ ใบไม้เปลี่ยนสี ขอให้สนุกกับการเดินทาง

『1901 TEA SALON』さんに行ってきました！🍵✨

1901年（明治34年）に建てられた歴史ある土蔵造りの古民家を改装した店内は、
まるで大正時代にタイムスリップしたかのような上品で癒やしの空間が広がっています。

天井が高く開放感のある1階席も素敵ですが、
特徴的な箱階段を上った先にある2階席は、
観光地の賑やかさとは対照的な静けさが心地よい特別な空間です。

「川越抹茶ババロア」と、ボリューム満点な「ぽたぽた団子」🍡💚

抹茶ババロアは、スプーンを入れた瞬間にわかるなめらかな舌触りで、
抹茶本来の濃厚な風味がしっかり楽しめます。
甘めのあんこと生クリーム、歯応えのあるあんずとの相性も最高です🤤

お茶は煎茶・ほうじ茶・和紅茶の3種類から選べる本格的な狭山茶。
急須から注ぐ瞬間の豊かな香りに癒やされながら、ゆっくりと贅沢なひとときを味わえます🌷

この地域の景色は、江戸時代の町並みと現代の都市機能、豊かな自然環境が織りなす、他では見られない特別な風景を生み出しています。

特に、小江戸と呼ばれる川越の歴史的町並みに咲く桜は、まさに川越にしか存在しない唯一無二の風景です。

 

夏は、伝統的な蔵造りの町並みと近代的な都市景観が融合した景色が広がります。

特に夕暮れ時の蔵造りの街並みは、他では見られない独特の魅力を放っています。

 

秋になると、川越市内の寺社や公園が鮮やかな紅葉に染まります。

特に、喜多院や川越城址公園の紅葉は、まるで自然が描いた絵画のようで、歴史的な建造物と紅葉のコントラストは息をのむほどの美しさです。

snippet.title: 【4K 国道16号夜間ドライブ】横田基地から入間・川越を通って埼玉へ帰る｜Yokota Air Base to Saitama Night Drive
snippet.description:
This 4K night driving video follows National Route 16 from the Yokota Air Base area in western Tokyo back toward Saitama City, capturing the atmosphere of the highway after dark.
Starting near Yokota Air Base in Fussa, the drive heads north along Route 16 through Mizuho before crossing the prefectural border into Saitama. The journey continues through Iruma, Sayama, and Kawagoe, passing illuminated commercial districts, major intersections, and quieter stretches of suburban road.
The area around Yokota Air Base is known for its distinctive American-influenced atmosphere. Along Route 16, the Fussa Base Side Street developed into a shopping district with restaurants and stores influenced by the nearby U.S. military base. The district's character reflects the long relationship between the base and the surrounding community.
Continuing east from Kawagoe, the route crosses the Arakawa River area and heads into Saitama City. The drive follows the familiar highway back toward Yoshinocho, completing the return journey from western Tokyo.
Unlike the earlier evening drive toward Yokota Air Base, this video captures the same general route in the opposite direction after nightfall. Enjoy the illuminated roads, passing vehicles, intersections, and everyday nighttime scenery along Route 16 in 4K with natural driving sounds.

Yokota Air Base Area → National Route 16 → Mizuho → Iruma → Sayama → Kawagoe → Saitama City / Yoshinocho Area
Location:

snippet.title: Kawagoe Matsuri 2024 #beautifuljapan #japan
snippet.description:
The Kawagoe Festival, held annually in October in Kawagoe City, Saitama Prefecture, is a traditional festival with a history spanning approximately 370 years.
 It is one of the largest festivals in Saitama Prefecture, attracting numerous visitors. Its charm lies in the magnificent parade of floats, the nostalgic atmosphere of “Koedo Kawagoe” (Little Edo), the vibrant participation of the local community, and the opportunity to experience history and culture. Below is a detailed explanation of its main attractions.

1. History and Tradition
The origins of the Kawagoe Festival date back to 1648 (Keian 1), when Matsudaira Nobutsuna, the lord of Kawagoe Domain, donated a portable shrine to Kawagoe Hikawa Shrine. Over time, this event evolved into the festival as it is known today, featuring a parade of floats. The festival is held on a weekend in mid-October as part of Kawagoe Hikawa Shrine’s annual grand festival. With its long history, the Kawagoe Festival has become a source of pride for local residents and a significant cultural heritage.

2. Magnificent Floats in Procession
The festival’s highlight is the spectacular procession of floats known as the Dashi Parade. Each neighborhood owns its float, crafted with exquisite traditional techniques and adorned with elaborate carvings and decorations. Atop the floats are figures representing famous kabuki characters or historical heroes, with each neighborhood presenting its unique theme.

When two floats meet, a dramatic “Hikkawase” (competition of floats) takes place. Here, the musical performances of the floats’ accompanying bands, featuring drums, flutes, and gongs, create an exciting atmosphere. These spirited exchanges peak the festival’s energy, captivating spectators. The Hikkawase continues into the night, where the floats are illuminated by lanterns, adding a magical, dreamlike ambiance distinct from the daytime festivities.

3. Fusion of Edo Atmosphere and the Festival
Kawagoe is known as “Koedo” (Little Edo) for its preserved townscapes reminiscent of the Edo period. Historic warehouses and traditional merchant streets create a picturesque setting for the festival, evoking the feeling of stepping back in time.

During the festival, the combination of historic architecture and the colorful floats creates a unique and captivating scene. Kawagoe’s townscape itself is a major tourist attraction, and the festival offers an unparalleled experience by integrating this cultural backdrop into its celebrations.

4. Community Spirit and Vibrancy
The Kawagoe Festival is driven by the active participation of local residents, with each neighborhood preparing its floats and musical performances. This collaboration strengthens community bonds and ensures the festival’s success year after year. From those pulling the floats to those playing music and the volunteers supporting the event, everyone contributes to its lively atmosphere.

Visitors can also participate in float-pulling activities, fostering interaction between locals and tourists. This strong sense of community and inclusiveness adds warmth and charm to the festival, making it a welcoming experience for all.

5. Experience of Traditional Performing Arts and Culture
The Kawagoe Festival provides opportunities to experience Japan’s traditional performing arts and culture. Beyond the float parade and Hikkawase, other events include the procession of portable shrines, traditional dances, and the display of kabuki figures. These events offer a rare chance to immerse oneself in Japanese culture, earning high praise from international visitors.

Special rituals at Kawagoe Hikawa Shrine during the festival period provide a sacred and solemn atmosphere, allowing visitors to glimpse Japan’s religious traditions. Additionally, local specialty products and traditional crafts sold during the festival make for popular souvenirs.

6. Enchanting Nighttime Festivities
The Kawagoe Festival is equally captivating at night. Lanterns illuminate the floats, casting a soft glow over the streets and creating an enchanting atmosphere. The contrast between the daytime’s lively energy and the nighttime’s serene beauty showcases the festival’s multifaceted charm, leaving a lasting impression on visitors.

7. Accessibility and Surrounding Attractions
One of the festival’s appealing aspects is its convenient accessibility. Located within walking distance of Kawagoe Station and Hon-Kawagoe Station, it is easy to reach from Tokyo and other urban areas. Visitors can also explore Kawagoe’s other attractions before or after the festival. Notable spots include the Toki no Kane (Bell Tower) and Kashiya Yokocho (Candy Alley), offering a variety of historical and cultural experiences.

snippet.title: 【川越】秋の川越。賑わいの小江戸を歩く
snippet.description:
秋晴れの祝日、小江戸川越を歩いてきました。

蔵造りの建物が並ぶ一番街は、多くの観光客で大にぎわい。
週末に川越まつりを控え、街は紅白幕で彩られています。

一番街から門前横丁へ。
一本路地に入っても素敵なお店が並び、
歩くたびに新しい発見があります。

昔ながらのお菓子屋さんが集まる菓子屋横丁も、
たくさんの観光客でにぎわっていました。

午後3時には、川越のシンボル「時の鐘」へ。
その鐘の音は意外なほど小さく、
街のざわめきの中に静かに溶け込んでいました。

最後は懐かしい揚げパン。

今回はBGMを使用せず、
街の環境音とともに川越の風景をお届けします。

小さなカメラ一台で切り取った、秋の小江戸。
一緒に街を歩くような気分でお楽しみください。

📍撮影地：埼玉県川越市

📷カメラ：DJI Osmo Pocket 4P

東京からもすぐに行ける小江戸・川越で、
大人気のスイーツ食べ歩き！
歴史ある蔵造りの街並みを歩きながら、
「福呂屋」のなめらかな“とのさまチーズケーキ”、
